thread:
Eleanor: quick UX callout: when you change the time-range preset the heatmap re-samples and the sampler control disappears briefly. users might think sampling toggled off.
Diego: good catch. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/range-sync-sampling. screenshot attached.
Priya: behavior feels janky. suggest keep sampler visible during transition and show a subtle toast: "Sampling preserved (10%) while range updates". also add a tiny inline badge on heatmap legend: "sampled 1/10".
Marcus: accessibility: toast needs role="status" so screen readers announce it but avoid focus steal. sampler toggle should have aria-label that includes current sampling rate e.g. "Sampling: Adaptive, 10% sampled".
Eleanor: also noticed keyboard users lose focus when the time range preset applies. focus should remain on the sampler control if it was focused before.
Diego: dev note: prefer CSS transform animations over reflow to keep focus stable. and for the sampler hit area use invisible padding to 44px. code sketch: `.sampler{width:24px;height:24px;position:relative}.sampler::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;}`
Priya: copy: change tooltip to "Sampling: Adaptive — balances latency and fidelity" full and "Sampling: Adaptive" compact. aggressive mode: "Aggressive — lower fidelity, lower cost". will draft i18n length notes.
Marcus: accessibility checklist: 1) aria-label includes mode + rate 2) `role=status` toast for non-modal announcements 3) maintain focus after presets 4) focus ring contrast >=3:1.
Eleanor: action items: 1) keep sampler visible during range transitions (owner: Diego) 2) ensure focus preservation for keyboard (owner: Marcus) 3) add sampled badge in legend (owner: Priya) 4) toast copy + aria behavior (owner: Marcus) 5) increase hit target and CSS prototype (owner: Diego).
Diego: will open PR for hit area + transition tweaks.
Priya: will upload copy variants and legend mock by EOD.
Marcus: I'll add a focus test to e2e and mock the screen reader announcement.
DesignBot: calendar invite created for 2026-04-02 09:30 PT for sign-off.
Eleanor: thanks all 1 closing thread, reopen if blockers arise.
